title: Reviewers run container-only: drop host sandbox detection
summary: The review pipeline no longer tries to detect whether osf runs inside the factory container, and no longer probes an agent's own read-only sandbox before starting it. Codex now always runs with `--dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox`, because the container is treated as the only wall; the `sandbox_check` field, the marker-file trust logic and the pre-flight check are gone. In exchange, each reviewer job now keeps its temporary home: `OSF_KEEP_REVIEW_HOME=1` plus `TMPDIR=/out/reviewer-home` make the child's stdout/stderr and session files land in a mounted folder that is uploaded as a diagnostic artifact, with seeded login files stripped out first.

lanes.label: GitHub Actions
lanes.subtitle: review.yml jobs
lanes.summary: The three reviewer jobs (codex, claude, opencode) each prepare a mounted reviewer-home folder, pass the keep-home environment into the container, and upload the folder as an artifact.

lanes.label: osf CLI
lanes.subtitle: crates/osf
lanes.summary: The review runner builds a reviewer roster, prepares a fresh home, runs the agent child, and now preserves that home when asked instead of always deleting it.

lanes.label: Reviewer agents
lanes.subtitle: codex / claude / opencode
lanes.summary: Codex loses its host read-only mode and sandbox check; every agent now runs in its single documented container mode.

lanes.label: Run artifacts
lanes.subtitle: uploaded from out/
lanes.summary: The kept reviewer home is uploaded alongside the existing answer JSON, giving a post-mortem record of child output and session files.

nodes.label: review.yml
nodes.subtitle: reviewer jobs + collector
nodes.summary: The workflow that runs each reviewer in the factory image and then collects their answers. This change adds a mounted reviewer-home directory, the keep-home environment variables, and an upload step per reviewer job.

nodes.label: review codex job
nodes.subtitle: docker run + upload
nodes.summary: Runs osf review run in the review image with CODEX_API_KEY. Now also sets OSF_KEEP_REVIEW_HOME=1 and TMPDIR=/out/reviewer-home, and uploads out/reviewer-home as review-home-codex.

nodes.label: review claude job
nodes.subtitle: docker run + upload
nodes.summary: Same shape as the codex job: keeps the reviewer home under the mounted out/ directory and uploads it as review-home-claude.

nodes.label: review-home-* artifact
nodes.subtitle: actions/upload-artifact
nodes.summary: The kept reviewer home, uploaded with if: always() so a failed run still leaves its child stdout/stderr and session files for diagnosis.

nodes.label: answer JSON artifact
nodes.subtitle: out/codex.json etc.
nodes.summary: The reviewer's validated answer, uploaded as before. It remains the only thing the collector job reads; the kept home is never an input to a verdict.

nodes.label: osf review run
nodes.subtitle: crates/osf/src/reviewers.rs
nodes.summary: The review entry point. It builds the roster, prepares each reviewer's home, runs the child, validates the answer, and now preserves the home when OSF_KEEP_REVIEW_HOME is set.

nodes.label: roster()
nodes.subtitle: reviewers::roster
nodes.summary: Builds the reviewer list from osf.toml. It no longer takes an in_container flag and no longer consults agents::in_factory_container; each reviewer is built in its own single container mode.

nodes.label: Reviewer::from_agent
nodes.subtitle: mode selection
nodes.summary: Chooses the read-only mode for a reviewer. The container-mode branch and the sandbox_check field are gone: read_only is now simply review.in_container.or(review.read_only).

nodes.label: run_child
nodes.subtitle: spawn + capture
nodes.summary: Spawns the agent, captures stdout and stderr, and now keeps the stderr text instead of discarding it: it is written into the preserved home, and a failed run prints its last non-empty line to the console.

nodes.label: preserve_home
nodes.subtitle: keep-home writer
nodes.summary: When OSF_KEEP_REVIEW_HOME is set, removes the seeded login files from the reviewer home and writes child.stdout and child.stderr into it. The home is a record only; nothing reads a verdict from it.

nodes.label: RunHome
nodes.subtitle: fresh home + Drop
nodes.summary: The per-run temporary home. Its Drop now checks keep_home() and leaves the directory in place, printing where it was kept, instead of always removing it.

nodes.label: check_sandbox
nodes.subtitle: pre-flight probe
nodes.summary: Ran the agent's own sandbox around a harmless command before the review and reported could-not-run on failure. Deleted along with the sandbox_check field and its 30-second limit.

nodes.label: in_factory_container
nodes.subtitle: marker trust logic
nodes.summary: Decided whether osf ran inside the factory container by trusting /opt/factory/bin/osf only when it was a root-owned, non-group-writable regular file and /.dockerenv existed. Deleted with its marker constants and tests.

nodes.label: AGENTS registry
nodes.subtitle: crates/osf/src/agents.rs
nodes.summary: The static table of agents and their review settings. The Review struct loses sandbox_check, and codex loses its host read-only mode, leaving only the in-container bypass mode.

nodes.label: codex
nodes.subtitle: --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox
nodes.summary: The codex reviewer. It now always runs with its own sandbox off, on the premise that the factory container is the wall; the --sandbox read-only mode and the codex sandbox -- true check are gone.

nodes.label: claude
nodes.subtitle: file tools, no shell
nodes.summary: Keeps its own read-only mode and never had a sandbox check, so its behaviour is unchanged; it is the neighbour that shows the new codex path is the odd one out.

nodes.label: opencode
nodes.subtitle: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
nodes.summary: Unchanged reviewer; it only gains the kept-home behaviour shared by every agent.

edges.label: job
edges.summary: The workflow defines the codex reviewer job and now passes the keep-home environment into it.

edges.label: osf review run
edges.summary: The job runs osf review run inside the review image, now with OSF_KEEP_REVIEW_HOME=1 and TMPDIR pointed at the mounted out/reviewer-home.
The run builds its reviewer list; roster no longer needs a container-detection answer to do it.
Each selected agent becomes a Reviewer in its single container mode.

edges.label: Review settings
edges.summary: Reads the agent's review settings, now without sandbox_check and with codex's read_only set to None.
The run spawns the agent child and captures its output.

edges.label: bypass sandbox
edges.summary: Codex is now always started with --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox; the host read-only path is unreachable.

edges.label: stdout + stderr
edges.summary: After the child exits, its captured output is handed to preserve_home, which writes it into the kept home.

edges.label: child.stdout / child.stderr
edges.summary: Writes the child's output into the run home and strips the seeded login files out of it.

edges.label: kept when OSF_KEEP_REVIEW_HOME
edges.summary: Drop leaves the directory in place when the keep-home variable is set, so the mounted folder survives the container and can be uploaded.

edges.label: upload-artifact
edges.summary: The job uploads out/reviewer-home as review-home-codex with if: always().

edges.label: pre-flight probe
edges.summary: The pre-flight sandbox probe that used to gate every reviewer run is gone.

edges.label: in_factory_container()
edges.summary: Roster no longer asks whether osf runs inside the factory container.

flows.title: One reviewer run, with its home kept
flows.summary: How a reviewer job turns into a kept home: the workflow passes the keep-home environment, osf builds the roster without container detection, runs the agent child, and writes the child's output into the mounted home before the container exits.

messages.label: OSF_KEEP_REVIEW_HOME=1, TMPDIR=/out/reviewer-home
messages.note: The job also pre-creates out/reviewer-home and mounts out/ into the container.

messages.label: roster() without container detection
messages.note: Each reviewer is built in its single container mode; codex gets read_only = None.

messages.label: codex exec --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox
messages.note: No sandbox check runs first any more; the container is the wall.

messages.label: child.stdout + child.stderr written, login files removed
messages.note: preserve_home strips the seeded login paths so no credential is uploaded.

messages.label: Drop keeps the directory
messages.note: Without the variable the home is removed as before.

steps.heading: Codex always bypasses
